name: enable_tidscan
description: Enables or disables the query planner's use of TID Scan plan nodes, which directly retrieve rows by tuple identifier (TID) when feasible.
symptoms: Suboptimal query plans for heap-only scans
Missed performance opportunities on narrow index-to-heap access patterns
Increased logical I/O for queries that could benefit from direct TID access
tuning_tips: Leave enabled unless profiling shows TID scans consistently produce worse plans than alternatives; disable only for targeted plan stability in edge cases involving volatile TID assumptions.
